annotations.title: Create seafarer profile draft from CV

description: Turn a seafarer CV (plain text the seafarer pasted or shared: sea service records, ranks, vessels, certificates) into a Krew Guru profile draft. Sends a sign-in code and link to the email in the CV (or to the email argument if the CV has none); the seafarer opens the email and enters the code on krew.guru to save the profile; no tool accepts that code. Returns the same result as the Krew Guru website: status (verification_sent, email_required, not_a_cv), masked email, handoff_url for the seafarer, up to 5 matched_vacancies, user_message and next_actions. Contacts and document numbers are not returned. If status is email_required, ask the seafarer for an email and call again with the same text and the email argument. Drafts expire after 24 hours. The seafarer's name is saved in English letters, as in the passport: if the CV writes the name in another script, transliterate it and add the passport spelling to raw_cv_text. Limit: 6 CVs per 10 minutes. Use this when the seafarer asks to create or update a Krew Guru profile from a CV or to find jobs matching a CV. Do not use for CVs of other people without their consent, for non-maritime CVs, or for employer or vacancy data.

email.description: The seafarer's own email. Only needed after status email_required; an email found in the CV is used first.

raw_cv_text.description: Full CV text as provided by the seafarer, 40-48,000 characters, any language. Keep sea service records (vessel name, IMO, type, rank, dates).
